name: StarLine Combo Popup
author: starlinewebsolu

sections.description:
StarLine Combo Popup is a lightweight WordPress plugin that helps you display eye-catching combo offer popups to first-time visitors on your website. Perfect for e-commerce stores, service providers, and businesses looking to boost conversions with limited-time offers.

Features

  • First-Time Visitor Detection – Shows popup only to new visitors
  • Enable/Disable Control – Toggle popup on/off from admin settings
  • Date Scheduling – Set start and end dates for time-limited offers
  • Customizable Content – Edit title, description, button text, and URL
  • Image Upload – Upload custom offer images via media library
  • Discount Badge – Automatic percentage badge display
  • Live Preview – See changes in real-time on settings page
  • Mobile Responsive – Works perfectly on all devices
  • Cookie-Based – Popup won’t reappear after dismissal for 24 hours
  • Lightweight – No jQuery dependency, optimized for performance
  • Admin-Friendly – Settings available under Settings > StarLine Combo

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Settings > StarLine Combo
  3. Configure your offer details (title, content, image, dates)
  4. Enable the popup and save settings
  5. The popup will automatically appear for first-time visitors

Default Settings

On activation, the plugin sets up default content:
* Title: “Special Combo Offer!”
* Content: “Get any 3 items and get 10% Flat discount. Hurry, limited time offer!”
* Default offer image included (SVG format)

Privacy

This plugin uses a single cookie (sl_cop_popup_dismissed) to track if a visitor has dismissed the popup. This cookie expires after 24 hours. No personal data is collected or stored.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

Credits

  • Developed by StarLine Web Solutions
  • Default offer image created using SVG (no external dependencies)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the starline-combo-popup folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > StarLine Combo to configure your popup
  4. Customize title, content, image, and schedule as needed
  5. Enable the popup and save your settings
sections.faq:
Can I customize the popup design?

Yes, you can customize the title, content, image, button text, and button URL from the admin settings. For advanced styling, you can override the CSS in your theme.

How do I disable the popup?

Go to Settings > StarLine Combo and uncheck the “Enable Popup” option. Save your changes.

Can I schedule the popup for specific dates?

Yes, set the Start Date and End Date fields in the Schedule Settings section. Leave them empty if you want the popup to always be active (when enabled).

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, the popup is fully responsive and works on all screen sizes.

Will the popup show to logged-in admins?

No, the popup is hidden for logged-in administrators so you can manage your site without interruptions.

How often does the popup show to the same visitor?

Once a visitor dismisses the popup, it won’t show again for 24 hours (controlled by cookie).
